description_en: Reads performance metrics (CloudMetrics) logs of E-HPC
name: GetCloudMetricLogs

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time is a timestamp. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The time is a timestamp. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return logs in reverse order of timestamps. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
按时间逆序返回日志。
默认值：false
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en:
The data aggregation type. Valid values:

sum: the sum of the data
avg: the average value
max: the maximum value
min: the minimum value

Aggregation is disabled by default
parameters.help_zh:
数据聚合类别。取值范围：
sum：统计和。
avg：平均值。
max：最大值。
min：最小值。

默认不使用聚合
parameters.name: aggregation_type

parameters.help_en:
The data aggregation interval. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1, 10, 60, 600, and 3600.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
数据聚合间隔。单位：秒。

取值范围：1、10、60、600、3600。

默认值：1
parameters.name: aggregation_interval

parameters.help_en:
The dimensions of the performance metric. Valid values:

machine
process
network
disk
parameters.help_zh:
性能指标的维度。取值范围：
machine： 整机。
process：进程。
network：网络。
disk：磁盘
parameters.name: metric_scope

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions. A JSON-formatted string that contains several key-value pairs. Valid values of the key:

InstanceId: the ID of the node
Hostname: the hostname of the node
NetworkInterface: the name of the network interface
DiskDevice: the name of the disk
parameters.help_zh:
指定过滤条件。JSON格式字符串，包含若干key:value对。key的取值范围：
InstanceId：节点ID。
Hostname：节点主机名称。
NetworkInterface：网络接口名称。
DiskDevice：磁盘设备名称
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The category of the output performance metrics. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). Valid values:

cpu
memory
parameters.help_zh:
输出性能指标的类别，多个指标用半角逗号（,）隔开。取值范围：
cpu：CPU。
memory：内存
parameters.name: metric_categories

MetricData.description_en: A JSON-formatted serialized string that contains performance metric data of multiple categories
MetricData.description_zh: JSON序列化字符串，包含多个类别性能指标数值

NetworkInterface.description_en: The name of the network interface

Time.description_en: The timestamp of the log. The time is a timestamp. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
Time.description_zh: 日志时间戳。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
